prompt:
Character dialogue portrait for a 2D narrative adventure game. Style: clean hand-drawn digital storybook illustration; confident dark-brown ink outlines of even medium weight around every shape; soft painted cel shading with one light tone and one shadow tone per material and only a few soft transitions; fur indicated by a few short strokes along the outlines instead of dense texture; the knitted scarf shown with simple rib stripes; flat, clean colour areas that read well at small size. Muted dusk palette: moss and bottle green, brick red, cream, warm brown, charcoal and off-white. A warm orange rim light along the right edge of the figure, as from an evening lantern, and a cool, soft blue-violet fill light from the left. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a plush toy, no airbrush glow, no heavy texture, no painted background.
Framing: square bust portrait from the top of the cap down to the waist, front view; the character faces the viewer directly and symmetrically, head upright and centred horizontally, a little free space above the cap; the head with the cap takes up about the upper half of the image; both shoulders and upper arms are inside the frame; the body is cut off by the bottom edge of the image at the waist.
Face: calm and friendly; both eyes open and looking straight at the viewer, round dark-brown eyes with a black pupil, a small white highlight and a clearly drawn upper eyelid line; the mouth closed in a small gentle smile below the black nose; both ears clearly visible beside the cap.
Costume arrangement: the long red knitted scarf is wrapped around the neck, its upper edge covering the bottom of the muzzle; one scarf end hangs down straight in front of the chest on the right side of the picture, free and not tucked in, ending well above the bottom edge; the satchel strap runs diagonally across the chest; the arms hang relaxed at the sides; the parcel is held under the arm on the left side of the picture at the bottom edge, partly cut off.
The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.
The attached reference images only define the costume, colours and proportions of the character (front view); drawing style, lighting and framing follow this description.
The character is isolated on a fully transparent background (alpha channel): nothing behind the figure, no ground, no cast shadow, no frame, no vignette.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: square 1:1.
